title: Serina Therapeutics Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
summary: Phase 1b Registrational Clinical Study of SER-252 Underway in Advanced Parkinson’s Disease; TFL data from the SAD study arm targeted for first half of 2027 - – Closed $21.2 million private placement financing to support continued advancement of SER-252 – HUNTSVILLE, May 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Serina Therapeutics, Inc.
